title: Semantic names are allowed only when the role is evidenced; define aliases are not allowed
summary: Names must improve reviewability without inventing meaning; an invented semantic name is rejected.
A semantic name is required to carry supporting evidence; without it, fn_/lbl_/address-style names must stay, and temp_rXX names must be cleaned once a local role is clear.

A global, extern, or data symbol has one canonical name backed by source, symbol, map, or review evidence; hiding a rename behind an identifier-to-identifier define, or keeping duplicate address-commented extern declarations for one address, is rejected.
A game record may require maintainer review for every rename; when it does, that record wins.
do: Use a semantic name only when source, callsite, data, or review evidence supports the role.
Keep address-style names when meaning is not proven; renaming them without evidence is rejected.
Use short local role names such as fp, ip, gp, and obj when roles are clear.
Preserve existing global, data, and extern names; perform a real scoped rename only when evidence supports it, and update references directly.
Keep one canonical declaration for one known data address in the owning scope.
do_not: Rename address-style symbols before source meaning is supported, or because an external mirror, decompiler, or AI output guessed the role.
Leave temp_rXX-style names when a clear local role is known.
Add #define old_name new_name or #define new_name old_name to hide a renamed variable, avoid updating call sites, or make a guessed name appear accepted.
Keep two extern declarations with different names for the same address-commented data symbol.
evidence_refs: user-provided review comment: Avoid renaming variables and using defines in their place.
preferred_repairs: Use a semantic name only when local evidence proves the role.
Replace generated temp/var/phi local names with conservative role names when the role is clear.
Keep one canonical symbol name or perform an evidenced scoped rename directly; guessed names and missing declarations hidden behind defines are rejected.
provenance: Merged no-define-alias-global-renames into this record; define_alias rebound here (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 5).

title: Headers, prototypes, and includes must be truthful
summary: When a body proves a signature, updating the owning header and removing UNK_RET/UNK_PARAMS is required; leaving a mismatched prototype is rejected.

Established include style is required and the project's missing-prototype check must run when prototype or include surfaces change; there are no exceptions to declaring a symbol in its real owning header.
do: Update prototypes when a function body proves the signature.
Put declarations in the real owning header; a fake source-local declaration is rejected.
Use established local include style and run the project's prototype check when prototype or include surfaces change.
do_not: Add fake source-local declarations when the real header should own them.
Leave mismatched prototypes after recovering a function body.
Hide missing prototypes behind local declarations.
preferred_repairs: Move declarations to the owning header when a body proves the signature.
Remove source-local declarations that hide missing prototypes or same-TU visibility.
provenance: Include-shim construct moved to no-symbol-forgery (header_override_macro); the Melee configure.py --require-protos step moved to the Melee game slice.
